Gmail 给的短摘要，判断要不要细读用: The short snippet Gmail provides, for deciding whether to read the full email
与 Gmail 搜索框同一套语法，如 is:unread from:boss@x: Same syntax as the Gmail search box, e.g. is:unread from:boss@x.com newer_than:2d
勾选后逐封拉详情（慢且更耗配额）；只要 id 就别勾: When checked, fetches full details for each email (slower and uses more quota); leave unchecked if you only need the id
打一次 Gmail 的 users.getProfile，报授权是否还有效、授的: Calls Gmail's users.getProfile once, reporting whether the authorization is still valid and which mailbox it's for
授权后由平台自动换取，勿手填: Automatically obtained by the platform after authorization; do not fill in manually
新邮件事件源自动维护，勿手填: Automatically maintained by the new-email event source; do not fill in manually
来自「列邮件」或新邮件事件: From "List emails" or the new-email event
来自「读邮件」输出的 attachments: From the attachments output of "Read email"
点凭证行的「授权」获取，勿手填: Obtained by clicking "Authorize" on the credential row; do not fill in manually
落盘用；留空则用附件自带的名字: Used when saving to disk; leave empty to use the attachment's own name
该邮件的标签 id 列表: The list of label ids on this email
该邮件的标签 id 列表（如 INBOX/UNREAD/CATEGORY_PRO: The list of label ids on this email (e.g. INBOX/UNREAD/CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS)
读写你的 Gmail：列邮件 / 读邮件 / 发邮件，并可作为事件源——收到新邮: Read and write your Gmail: list emails / read emails / send emails, and it can also act as an event source — triggering a workflow when a new email arrives.
邮件列表；with_detail=false 时每项只有 id/thread_i: The list of emails; when with_detail=false, each item only has id/thread_id populated
附件清单；字节要用「取附件」再拉: The attachment list; fetch the bytes separately with "Get attachment"
